why: RJ-P70 (suiteui/orientation-crop OC-12): Photo's image.flip mirrors the whole canvas through the kernel's Orientation. On a 48 x 32 gradient with a 16 x 10 patch layer at (6, 4) above it, flips the whole canvas horizontally and exports the PNG. The trap: only the selected layer flips, or the patch keeps its old offset so the composite shifts. The assertion: the PNG equals the original PNG mirrored, pixel for pixel (PhotoOrientationTests.flipCanvasRealJob).
